rows.question: Absolute key predicts success
rows.GEMINI_A: A initially implied a privileged C# key; not established
rows.CLAUDE_B: 24 reported keys in 168 rows; several arrangement/database conflicts
rows.CHATGPT_C: 7 reported keys in 42 entities; no controls
rows.accepted_statement: No defensible winning key. Transpose for the voice.

rows.question: Winning tempo pocket
rows.CLAUDE_B: 25 global feature rows; median 110, heterogeneous beat units
rows.CHATGPT_C: 6 BPM values in 42; sparse recent coverage
rows.accepted_statement: No age/artist-adjusted BPM effect; zone ranges are proposals.

rows.question: Shorter/earlier always improves retention
rows.CLAUDE_B: Historical duration/intro trends; unsupported deadlines in zones
rows.CHATGPT_C: 2025 US examples include later chorus arrivals
rows.accepted_statement: No private retention. Structure has several workable forms.

rows.question: Major versus minor
rows.CLAUDE_B: 14 major,8 minor,2 modal,1 unknown in selected global feature cell
rows.CHATGPT_C: Reported Hindi examples include both labels
rows.accepted_statement: Era, market, source and selection differ; no preferred mode inferred.

rows.question: Indian crossover exists
rows.CLAUDE_B: 0 intersection in selected all-time top lists
rows.accepted_statement: Top-list absence does not imply no export. Export does not prove broad non-diaspora adoption.

rows.question: Repeatability/replay
rows.accepted_statement: Population persistence is not individual replay rate.

rows.question: Age normalization
rows.GEMINI_A: No valid timestamped official counter join
rows.CLAUDE_B: Approximate lifetime views/day for dated rows, undated counters
rows.CHATGPT_C: Annual outcome windows, not release-age normalization
rows.accepted_statement: No validated launch-window comparison or regression across tracks.

rows.question: Vocal selection
rows.CLAUDE_B: Arrangement ranges and proposed hard constraints
rows.CHATGPT_C: Comfortable phrase-based audition; no observed Nitin range
rows.accepted_statement: Prompt agreement is not independent scientific evidence; no numerical Nitin fit.

rows.question: Production and structure
rows.CLAUDE_B: No measured per-song hook/chorus timing; aggregate literature
rows.CHATGPT_C: One report-based chorus boundary; most fields missing
rows.accepted_statement: Annotate exact recordings before claiming reference structure as measured.
